device.basis: Unidentified block of X-T20 2.11 section 5 with channels at 0xfff1b000 + 0x1000*n (0xc53c9c maps channel 0..2). 0xc538bc reads +0x1f4 and, only when bit 4 is set, writes a mode to +0x10 (0xc54014); its caller 0xccfad8, reached through function tables at 0xf7be60.., first programs clocks and pins (0xc698b8, 0xc6a4b4, 0xc6a508). Its drivers 0xc53660..0xc54100 are called only from the sound code between the sound task entries (0xcc8af8, 0xccb9cc) and the wave task (0xccfc08..0xccff20, 0xcd4cfc..0xcd5428), so the block is most likely the audio interface; the sound, audio, beep, wave and voicecont tasks wait for messages in REC and the menu. Other words are written by 0xc53ccc..0xc53fd4. What +0x1f4 bit 4 reports on the camera is not known and no capture records it; the block reads it clear, so 0xc538bc returns -255 without writing the mode, as in the xpro-lab emulator. The words read back their last write.
